# coolify_gitlab_app (Data Source)

Reads a Coolify GitLab App by id or uuid. Requires Coolify >= v4.3.0.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "coolify_gitlab_app" "example" {
  id = 7
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) Numeric Coolify id.
- `uuid` (String) UUID.

### Read-Only

- `api_url` (String)
- `client_id` (String)
- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive)
- `custom_port` (Number)
- `custom_user` (String)
- `group_name` (String)
- `html_url` (String)
- `is_system_wide` (Boolean)
- `name` (String)
- `redirect_uri` (String)
- `webhook_token` (String, Sensitive)
